trigger.activation: explicit user selection of constant_potential profile; never inferred from pair_style or task name alone
spec_conditions: user provides electrode groups, potential convention, boundary mode

renderer_extensions.description: emit kspace_style pppm/electrode or ewald/electrode; never plain pppm
emit fix electrode/conp with user-provided potentials, symm, ffield; fix_modify energy yes
emit electrode charge monitoring (compute reduce sum q) and charge in dump

static_rules.description: fix electrode/* requires kspace_style pppm/electrode or ewald/electrode; plain pppm crashes
electrode groups must be explicitly defined; no >>> USER placeholder on active group lines
bot and top electrode groups must be disjoint; electrolyte must subtract both
boundary p p p requires ffield yes in fix electrode; p p f requires kspace_modify slab and no ffield
electrode potentials in fix electrode/conp must be explicit values, not >>> USER markers
electrode charge monitoring should be present for CONP diagnostics
constant_potential requires atom_style full (charges and bonds for electrolyte)

steps: run 0: electrode matrix solve, check convergence and no NaN in charges
short NVT at 0 V 50 to 100 steps: check charge equilibration and no lost atoms
verify no electrolyte atoms assigned to electrode groups
checks: return code 0 and log contains Loop time
no ERROR, lost atoms, or NaN or Inf in log
electrode total charge is finite and non-zero at target potential
no electrolyte atom type appears in electrode group definitions

required_evidence.metric: electrode charges stabilized at 0 V from a real LAMMPS run
electrode charges stable at target potential from a real LAMMPS run

outputs: trajectory with charges (dump custom id type x y z q)
electrode charge time series (compute reduce sum q via fix ave/time)
thermo log (step temp pe etotal c_qbot c_qtop)
handoff_targets: post-processing skill for charge fluctuation analysis
electrochemistry workflow for capacitance and differential charge
